name: Bilt Blue

benefits.name: Points on Rent and Mortgage Payments
benefits.description: Earn points on rent or mortgage paid through Bilt, the program's signature benefit — housing payments normally earn nothing on a credit card.
benefits.terms: Housing earning is conditional, and sources disagree on the exact mechanics: Doctor of Credit describes 1x points where a 3% transaction fee applies unless offset by Bilt Cash, while CNBC Select describes up to 1.25x with no transaction fee subject to minimum everyday-spend thresholds scaled to your monthly payment. Verify against Bilt's own current terms before relying on a specific rate. Works with any landlord or lender, including mortgages.

benefits.name: 4% Back in Bilt Cash on Purchases
benefits.description: All card spending earns 4% back in Bilt Cash in addition to points. Bilt Cash is a separate currency from points, used to offset housing transaction fees.
benefits.terms: Bilt Cash expires yearly, with a maximum of $100 carrying over. Points themselves do not expire. Gift cards, tax payments, and person-to-person payments are excluded from earning.

earningRates.terms: 1x points on everyday spending, plus 4% back in Bilt Cash (tracked as a benefit, not an earning rate, since it is a separate currency).

_note: Added 2026-09-14 from the Bilt Card 2.0 launch (live 2026-02-07); replaces the discontinued wells-fargo-bilt. Card art is the genuine asset from the MaxRewards CDN (slug 'bilt-blue') and shows this card is a World Elite Mastercard — note that Doctor of Credit's write-up said Blue carried no Mastercard tier designation, which the art contradicts. All rate figures come from reputable secondary coverage, not Bilt's own terms page (biltrewards.com 403s automated fetches); re-verify against the issuer before treating the housing rate as settled.
